strings.groups.1.sections.6.paras.1: 如果您在车站内或上车时需要协助，请在列车发车前至少 1 小时到达车站，并在到达时告知沙特铁路公司的工作人员。
strings.groups.1.sections.6.src.2.label: 沙特铁路公司：特殊协助

decisions: Operator in the paragraph: 沙特铁路公司 alone — termbase rule (（SAR） only at first mention on the page, already given in groups.0.sections.1.src.1.label; p0 of this section already uses the bare form).
Label prefix copied from sibling src[1] 沙特铁路公司：车票类别; topic 特殊协助 = literal 'special assistance', same noun 协助 as the paragraph; 重点旅客服务 rejected as China Railway's own programme name.
Register 您/请 per termbase style_rules.tone and the approved transport batch; 上车 and 发车 taken from the approved batch (groups.1.sections.1.paras.0, groups.0.sections.3.table.head.1).
1 小时 with Latin digit and half-width spaces, per the Latin-digit rule and the page's 每 20 分钟 format.
Facts kept whole: 至少 / 1 小时 / 发车前 / 到达车站 / 到达时告知工作人员; 列车 added only to make the subject train explicit after p0's Uber sentence.
unverified: SAR has no Simplified Chinese site I could verify, so the operator's own zh wording of the instruction and of the page title is unknown.
特殊协助 as a page heading is not attested on a rail site in my search (airline headings found: 特殊帮助 Finnair cn-zh, 残障及行动辅助 Cathay sc_CN).
